configurations.name: Hide business address on Contact
configurations.source: Global Contact setting. When business collection is effectively hidden (no selected product-scope exception), hide all business controls and the correspondence question; persist the global Home correspondence value. Business address drafts remain retained.

configurations.name: Hide correspondence choice on Contact
configurations.source: Global Contact setting. Hide the correspondence question and persist the global Home value. Automatic employer/business collection remains governed independently by current product scope.

configurations.name: Products that automatically enable Contact business information
configurations.source: Global Contact product-scope capability. Empty uses DI/OO for automatic collection; a nonempty effective-Site list uses selected assigned products instead and provides exceptions to hide-business-address. When business collection is not effectively hidden, choosing Business correspondence independently reveals address-only fields even for products outside automatic scope. Current URL-filtered product/applicant elections determine participation.
